description: CVE vectors used to cost exploit actions (plan section 9.3). Each vector is the CVSS v3.1 vector published by nvd@nist.gov (Primary entry when NVD has one, otherwise the nvd@nist.gov entry). Only exploitability metrics (AV, AC, PR, UI, S) enter the cost; no exploit code is involved.
selection_rule: One or more well-known CVEs per attack role (remote initial access, lateral movement over a network service, local privilege escalation, domain takeover, client-side access). Candidates must be listed in the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog (field cisaExploitAdd in NVD) and have a CVSS v3.1 entry from nvd@nist.gov. All candidates considered are listed here, whether or not a scenario uses them. Within a role, scenario actions are ordered by ascending CVE id.
integrity_check: For every entry, round(Exploitability computed from the vector, 1) must equal nvd_exploitability (checked by tests/test_aapef.py).
